text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER P123456 - KV cache runaway detected in continuous-batching path. Multiple tenants seeing latency cliffs and request spikes. Paging #eng-oncall.

sujay patel: I'm on call. grabbing logs + metrics now. any initial impact numbers? :eyes:

ops-bot: metric spike: kvcache.memory.used per-shard jumped 4x in 10m; pending_requests_per_shard up 300%. error_rate_nginx 502s -> 4.8% from 0.2%.

maria nguyen: seeing repeated draft/target desync on speculative-decoding for model open-vicuna-13b-q; speculative decoder threads creating duplicate KV entries -> cache churn.

jessica (jess) chen: confirmed. traces show many short-lived prefixes being written and evicting hot keys. suspected interplay: speculative-decoding creating many transient drafts, continuous-batching batching them, causing amplification.

sujay patel: OK. immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle continuous-batching by setting batch.max_window_ms=10 -> 5ms conservative 2) disable speculative-decoding feature flag for affected model 3) enforce per-tenant KV cap. I'll attempt 1 & 2 first.

maria nguyen: +1. I'm ready to flip flags. Who owns k8s deploy for runtime?

ops-bot: Runtime fleet leader: tim lee.

tim lee: here. I'll coordinate the rollout and watch GPUs. sujay, give me the exact commands you want.

sujay patel: For runtime config, patch configmap:
```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap runtime-config \
  --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/batch.max_window_ms","value":"5"}]'
```
Then feature flag:
```
infractl feature set speculative_decoding false --model open-vicuna-13b-q --env prod
```
And enforce KV cap:
```
infractl kvcap set --tenant any --limit 10MB --mode enforce
```

jessica (jess) chen: I'll prepare quick rollback commands if anything regresses. Also let's add a temporary sampling rule to drop non-SLAs.

eng-sre: Noted. We'll open an incident ticket and call out affected tenants. Is there customer-visible 503s?

ops-bot: Top impacted customers: 3 high-volume tenants in prod region us-west-2. 503s peaked at 1200rps across the fleet for ~8m.95th latency for generation requests jumped from 230ms -> 1.8s.

maria nguyen: ETA for flag flip is ~2m. We'll do one-region canary then global.

sujay patel: Starting the batch window patch now (canary to 1 node group).

oncall-bot: Deploy started: runtime-config patch -> nodegroup canary-1.

jessica (jess) chen: Observability checklist: watch kvcache.hits, kvcache.evictions, batch.size, latency_p95, error_rate. I'll share a small dashboard link in thread.

ops-bot: Canary metrics 60s after change: kvcache.evictions down 72%, pending_requests_per_shard down 55%, error_rate -> 1.1%. latency_p95 -> 690ms.

tim lee: Good signal. Proceed to flip speculative_decoding flag in canary region.

maria nguyen: Flag flipped in canary. Monitoring.

ops-bot: After flag flip: speculative_decoder.spawn_count -80%, duplicate_kv_writes drop -86%, error_rate 0.4% in canary.

sujay patel: Rollout to remaining regions in 2 waves. Keep per-tenant cap enforcement only enabled in prod after second wave.

eng-sre: Update incident ticket: severity P2 -> customer-impacting but mitigated. Add note: mitigation via batching limits + speculative flag rollback.

tim lee: Rolling config and flag globally now. Command run: `kubectl rollout restart ds/runtime-pod -n inference` (staggered).

ops-bot: Global rollout in progress. ETA ~6m.

jessica (jess) chen: Watching. Also noticed memory spike on a specific shard that persisted; isolating with `node-exporter` logs. Might need a pod restart for that shard.

sujay patel: If any pod shows >90% mem for >3m, we'll cordon and restart. Prep a hotfix branch to revert the speculative decoder patch (if needed) and a config override to permanently set batch.max_window_ms=8ms for the next 24h.

ops-bot: Global metrics 3m post-rollout: kvcache.evictions -68% global, error_rate 0.25%, latency_p95 280ms. Impacted customers reporting reduced errors.

maria nguyen: Good. I'll open a postmortem draft and start collecting timeline: when speculative-decoding change landed, which commit, and recent kvcache GC/eviction param changes.

eng-sre: Also add runbook step to add synthetic prompt sets that exercise speculative paths so we catch this earlier.

tim lee: One pod needed restart during rollout (node-az3-runtime-12), restarted, came back healthy. No further restarts required.

sujay patel: Customer impact summary for SLT: ~3 tenants saw transient 502/503s lasting median 6m, peak 12m. Overall platform request success rate improved to baseline after mitigations. No data loss.

jessica (jess) chen: We'll keep conservative batching for 24h and monitor traffic shape. Ops: schedule maintenance window if we want to restore speculative-decoding with additional guards.

maria nguyen: Agreed. Postmortem owners: Maria + Sujay. Action items: 1) Add per-model speculative-decoding rate limit 2) Add synthetic workloads 3) Adjust default batch.max_window_ms from 20 -> 8ms 4) Add eviction KPI alerting.

oncall-bot: Handoff: sujay (primary) -> maria (secondary) at 1967881500. If anything degrades, page eng-oncall again.

sujay patel: I'm clearing the page for now. I'll stay nearby for 30m. Great work team. :thumbsup:

maria nguyen: I'll own the postmortem and customer impact notes for comms.

eng-sre: Closing the incident channel when postmortem draft is linked.

ops-bot: Incident P123456 state: mitigated -> monitoring. Logs saved to s3://redwood-incidents/P123456/logs.

jessica (jess) chen: Filing follow-up tickets and PRs now. Will reference this thread.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident P123456: mitigated at 1967881567.
